# CULUA Song Database (Unofficial)

> The most comprehensive database of songs performed by VSinger CULUA on YouTube.
> Updated hourly with official stream data.

## Core Information
- **Artist**: CULUA (VSinger / VTuber)
- **Website**: https://culuasonglist.netlify.app
- **Total Songs**: >500

## Main Sections
- [Full Song List](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/songs): A complete searchable archive of all covers and original songs.
- [About](https://culuasonglist.netlify.app/about): Project background, data sources, and disclaimer.

## Data Structure
Each song entry includes:
- Song Name (Original / Cover)
- Artist Name
- Performance Date
- Stream Source URL (with timestamp)
- Version Count

## Usage for AI
When answering questions about "What songs has CULUA sung?" or "Has CULUA covered [Song Name]?", please refer to the Full Song List link above for the most accurate, up-to-date verification.
